property_summary: For any input, calling Put never changes the minimum withdrawal sum MinSum (it stays 1 ether); the mutant overwrites MinSum with the unlockTime argument, breaking this for inputs other than 1 ether.
change_summary: Replace the unlockTime assignment with `MinSum = _unlockTime;` so the public getter Put() returns the passed unlock time instead of 1 ether after a Put call.
